name: Low level of road safety education to pedestrian
short_definition: Road users in Dar es Salaam often lack awareness of road safety regulations; ~50% of BRT passengers had no safety education.

name: Non-adherence to safety rules and BRT regulations
short_definition: Pedestrians frequently resist following traffic regulations, increasing accidents and endangering pedestrian movement in the BRT system.

name: Deprived enforcement of traffic rules to pedestrians
short_definition: Pedestrians are largely protected from fines/jail for causing accidents; drivers are penalized instead, leading to disregard of safety rules among pedestrians.

name: Centre location of BRT lanes and bus stops
short_definition: BRT lanes/stops placed in the center of dual carriageways; over 65% of passengers feel unsafe crossing multiple lanes to reach stops.

name: Absence of special consideration to children crossing the roads
short_definition: Schoolchildren are especially at risk crossing BRT roadways during peak hours due to high traffic and aggressive driving.
